description: Public JSON feed for the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

novel_features.name: Flattened KEV vulnerability rows
novel_features.description: Flatten the CISA KEV feed into analyst-friendly vulnerability rows with vendor, product, CWE, due-date, and ransomware-use filters.

novel_features.name: KEV full-text search
novel_features.description: Search KEV entries across CVE IDs, vendors, products, vulnerability names, descriptions, required actions, notes, and CWEs.

novel_features.name: CVE one-look lookup
novel_features.description: Show one CISA KEV entry by CVE ID with normalized fields, catalog metadata, and parsed CWE output.

novel_features.name: Due-date and ransomware triage
novel_features.description: Sort and filter due-soon or overdue KEV entries, including known-ransomware-only triage for patch-priority workflows.
